<abbrev> Abbreviation or Acronym

Abbreviation, acronym, or emoticon used in the text of a document.

Usage/Remarks

The <abbrev> element is intended for marking abbreviations in running text.

Linking

Internal links: use <xref> with ref-type.
Attributes
alt
content-type
Tagged Samples
For abbreviation 
<p>...<abbrev>ckt</abbrev>...</p>
